I think the VRC+ group function should lean to the cosmetic functions(on the nameplate, or instance list, etc.) just like some other MMOs.

Since the friend don't have limit, the events in the Japanese communities just use Friend+ to hold events for years, which render their friend function useless and status being orange forever. Since the recent population explode, the new groups pops extremely quickly. Many world and artists, clubs have their own groups, and people will have to pick some of those, which likely the 'smaller/newer' will be ignored, with the limit the trend will soon being clogged and the flow will stops, the new groups have no room to growth, to compensate it either rolls back to the 'weird use' to the friend system and make the information slow down, or just stop being working since not everyone will use friend system for that(like me), and that basically against the reason why group system exists in the first place. The SNS clearly rely on the flow to the new stuffs, it will benefits literally no one if it got clogged

details:
Dear VRChat Team,

Your platform’s group feature is an excellent way to connect with others and engage in a variety of activities. However, I find the current limit of 200 groups quite restrictive. In the EU alone, there are over 400 active party groups, which highlights the rich diversity available.

Many users are forced to carefully choose which groups to join, often missing out on interesting communities as a result. Increasing the limit would allow everyone to fully take advantage of the platform’s potential and enjoy a wider range of activities.

I hope you will consider raising this limit.

--

Liebes VRChat-Team,

die Gruppenfunktion eurer Plattform ist eine großartige Möglichkeit, sich mit anderen Nutzern zu vernetzen und an spannenden Aktivitäten teilzunehmen. Allerdings empfinde ich das derzeitige Limit von 200 Gruppen als zu einschränkend. Allein in der EU gibt es über 400 aktive Party-Gruppen, was zeigt, wie vielfältig das Angebot ist.

Viele Nutzer müssen deshalb ständig abwägen, welchen Gruppen sie beitreten, und verpassen dabei oft interessante Communities. Eine Erweiterung des Limits würde es ermöglichen, das volle Potenzial der Gruppenfunktionen auszuschöpfen und noch mehr spannende Aktivitäten zu erleben.

Ich hoffe, ihr könnt über eine Erhöhung des Limits nachdenken.
title: Expanding Community Connections: Proposal to Increase VRChat's Group Limit
